title: [LOGGED OUT] Clicking the "Gold" tab shows the 5 gold offers with prices

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss; banner gone
Scrolled down 1150px; Store heading and tab bar visible

steps.text: Click the "Gold" tab (use the right arrow first if it is hidden).
steps.saw: Gold tab was cut off ('G') so clicked the right arrow (More categories) once, then clicked the Gold tab; page scrolled to the Gold section (screenshot taken during the scroll)

steps.text: Is the "Gold" heading visible on the screen?
steps.saw: Heading 'Gold' visible below the tab bar

steps.text: Is the "Gold" tab highlighted in yellow?
steps.saw: Gold tab has a yellow pill background; other tabs blue

steps.text: Are 5 cards shown: "Small pile of gold" (5000), "Piggy bank of gold" (25000), "Carpetbag of gold" (60000), "Goblet of gold" (140000) and "Strongbox of gold" (350000)?
steps.saw: 5 cards: Small pile of gold 5000, Piggy bank of gold 25000, Carpetbag of gold 60000, Goblet of gold 140000 visible; Strongbox of gold 350000 (5th) partly visible at the bottom of the screen, read from the page text (no extra scrolling done)

steps.text: Does each gold card have a green price button that starts with "USD" and a struck-through old price?
steps.saw: Buttons: USD 2.88 (3.20), USD 10.71 (11.89), USD 20.07 (22.30), USD 38.70 (42.99) shown with struck-through old prices; 5th card button USD 73.40 (81.55) read from the page text, below the visible screen
